QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` (`:85`) is an empty `asm volatile` that forces the value through a register. Without asm it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`, a `volatile` global that is 0 (`constant_time.c:29`), so the compiler cannot fold the value at compile time.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that stops the compiler from knowing the value, and places it in library/constant_time_impl.h at line 85.
